Revision: 82ac41c9a74f3cd0ee6ae44c6bdeb0c7328eb980
SpaceScan.cs SHA256: 936A77BB87449C7076DB8C701ADCA79EC21F16E84C1FE4135CF3C59DE97673DD
LiveScan.cs SHA256: F174F81207D0F54157BD12A2ECA0443891C4EEC21368DED083038C8E3443A8A0
Adapted into SpaceScan.cs: native metadata enumeration/long paths, scoped
directory traversal/accounting, progressive immutable value publication.
Pathweft owns cancellation, SQLite fallback measurements, SDK queries and UI.
No donor app/static state, MFT/raw-volume access, search/duplicate/history UI,
endpoint application, MCP or Coordinator runtime is imported.
